purpose: Replace exhaustive materialization of every conditional support point with an exact fixed-score support-function oracle and LP constraint generation, without changing the finite-CMLE existence estimand or converting computational uncertainty into evidence of an interior solution.

known_results_not_prospective.exhaustive_fixtures: All 93 registered controls matched their expected structural, boundary, or interior status.
known_results_not_prospective.retained_primary: At a deliberately low 50000-configuration cap, the exhaustive replay returned 63 structural, 13 boundary, 47 interior, and 227 typed unavailable results.
known_results_not_prospective.high_cap_sentinels: Six chain_strong/hub_strong representative cases were interior at 192745-217093 enumerated configurations.
known_results_not_prospective.interpretation: These results motivate scalability work. They cannot be counted as prospective oracle validation, and the 227 unavailable cases cannot be presumed interior.

mathematical_contract.unchanged_estimand: For every pattern-score stratum, require d'*(n_s*T-t_obs_s) <= 0 for every attainable sufficient statistic T. A nonzero feasible d is a supporting direction and withholds finite-CMLE existence.
mathematical_contract.support_oracle: For a proposed direction d, dynamic programming over response unit, bounded category, and fixed raw-score state must return the exact maximum of d'T and one maximizing sufficient statistic without enumerating all response vectors.
mathematical_contract.constraint_generation: Solve each bounded coordinate LP on the current valid cut set, call the oracle for every observed stratum, add normalized violating support rows, and repeat until no stratum has a violation above the registered binary64/solver tolerance.
mathematical_contract.interior_proof: Interior may be reported only after all positive and negative coordinate objectives have been oracle-certified at every registered tolerance.
mathematical_contract.boundary_proof: Boundary may be reported only when a nonzero coordinate solution is oracle-certified and the direct exact conditional likelihood trace is nondecreasing along the retained direction.
mathematical_contract.rank_precedence: Existing exact prefit structural rank deficiency remains authoritative and is reported before support-oracle work.

implementation_contract.cut_normalization: Divide each nonzero support row by its maximum absolute component before LP insertion; retain raw and normalized maximum violations.
implementation_contract.tie_handling: A deterministic maximizing response vector is sufficient for a positive violation; repeated oracle calls must add further tied rows if they remain violated.
implementation_contract.cut_reuse: Valid support cuts may be shared across coordinate objectives within one tolerance but each tolerance audit remains separately certified.
implementation_contract.fail_closed: LP failure, no-progress violation, iteration/cut/work/memory cap, tolerance disagreement, nonfinite oracle state, or failed directional verification yields unavailable/review, never interior.
forbidden_shortcuts: using optimizer estimates, standard errors, or MnSq to infer existence
silently accepting the current cut set without a full stratum-oracle pass
relaxing tolerances after observing a difficult retained case
treating an unavailable exhaustive result as an oracle interior result without prospective oracle execution

validation_contract.unit_oracle_equivalence: For every stratum in all 93 registered fixtures, compare oracle maximum values with maxima over the exhaustively enumerated unique support at deterministic coordinate, alternating, and seeded pseudo-random directions.
validation_contract.status_equivalence: Match exhaustive status across all 93 fixtures, every retained case completed by the primary exhaustive audit, and all six high-cap sentinels; structural cases are included in accounting but do not require oracle execution.
validation_contract.retained_replay: Audit all same-byte 350 connectivity cases and produce a typed status for all 287 prefit-eligible inputs.
validation_contract.tolerance_stability: Retain all tolerance-specific solver results, oracle violations, cut counts, rounds, and directions; disagreement is not majority-voted.
validation_contract.numerical_invariance: Do not alter fit_cmle, optimizer outputs, WLE, Person fit, raw MnSq, rounded MnSq, or current readiness bytes. The oracle only projects an additional gate.
adversarial_controls: near-boundary samples with one minority discordance
multi-Rater monotone, opposing, and disconnected graphs
correct, complete, and differentially contaminated hard anchors

success_gates.oracle_value_equivalence: Zero comparison failures at absolute tolerance 1e-10 times max(1, absolute exhaustive maximum).
success_gates.status_equivalence: Zero structural/boundary/interior disagreements against every registered exhaustive result.
success_gates.retained_accounting: 350/350 cases ledgered; 287/287 prefit-eligible cases receive structural, boundary, interior, or a typed oracle failure.
success_gates.directional_verification: Zero nonmonotone exact-objective traces among reported boundary directions.
success_gates.tolerance_stability: Zero coerced decisions; any cross-tolerance disagreement is explicitly unavailable.
success_gates.public_ui: withheld regardless of pass; public integration requires a separate UX and cross-engine review

interpretation_limits.solver_precision: The procedure is exact in discrete support search but still uses binary64 LP feasibility tolerances; exact rational polyhedral certification is not claimed.
interpretation_limits.existence_only: An interior result does not establish fit, fairness, anchor validity, local independence, unbiased estimates, or useful Person scoring.
interpretation_limits.anchor_scope: Hard anchors change the free-coordinate cone and may remove a separating direction; this is a conditional result under fixed anchor values, not proof that the anchors are unbiased.
interpretation_limits.cross_engine: Agreement with immer, TAM, sirt, or mfrmr boundary behavior is not presumed because estimator definitions and boundary handling may differ.
